feature: Hardware abstraction boundaries + deterministic npm dependency completeness validation
contracts: dependency validity is independent of NovaOryn IDE release version
an installed npm tree is reusable only after required package manifests are verified
partial npm trees trigger exactly one clean dependency installation
dependency-state markers cannot be written for a tree missing @theia/cli or other required pinned runtime packages
checks: Build does not infer dependency completeness from Electron and @theia/electron alone.
Required external packages from the root, Electron and extension manifests are verified before reuse.
A partial installed tree is removed and installed once before build continuation.
VerifyDependencies requires @theia/cli and @vscode/windows-ca-certs before writing the dependency marker.
